scope: Language-neutral adapter contract for cancellation, one page, value preservation and explicit refusals. This file documents expectations only; it is not proof that any adapter or provider is implemented or tested against a live service.

cancellation.rule: A caller abort stops header, network and body work, rejects with a redacted cancellation error, and never returns a late page. The adapter's own deadline is reported separately from a caller abort. A hostile cancel() implementation is not awaited.

page.cursorRule: Return nextCursor only when another page may exist. It is opaque and adapter-bound: pass it back unchanged, never construct or reuse it under a different query, endpoint or identity.
page.typeRule: Preserve the JSON value the provider returns without stringifying numbers or coercing null. 64-bit integers, decimals, dates, binary values and vendor-specific types require an adapter-specific documented conversion.

refusals.rule: When an adapter's capability descriptor classifies a feature as unsupported, refuse before any provider request with a typed unsupported error. Never silently ignore, emulate with an unbounded scan, or mislabel a provider search DSL as another engine.
